correctness.rationale: For t>0 the Hessian of the trace exponential in any nonzero symmetric direction is the sum of squared spectral-basis entries times strictly positive integrated exponential factors. The edge-to-Laplacian map is injective, so compactness gives a unique minimizer and uniqueness gives continuity on (0,∞). At fixed B, tr L=2B and the Taylor remainder is uniformly O(t³) on the simplex. The quadratic coefficient has matrix T=tridiag(1,4,1), and solving Ty=1 with y₀=yₙ=0 gives the stated alternating geometric formula. The two boundary terms in its numerator have magnitude at most 2ρ<1−ρⁿ, proving positivity and feasibility of the normalized stationary point; subtracting the first two recurrence equations gives 3(y₁−y₂)=y₃>0, also for n=4. Uniform convergence and uniqueness yield the short limit. For the long limit the centered linear test vector bounds λ₂ even at disconnected allocations. For the proposed wᵢ=c i(n−i), the path polynomial operator has leading action c k(k+1) on degree k: the backward-minus-forward coefficient is linear with leading term 2i, and the sum has leading term −2i². Evaluation on the n vertices triangularizes it through degree n−1, so the gap is exactly 2c. Equality for any other allocation in the fixed-vector Rayleigh bound forces the same weights by summing the node equations. The minimum heat trace bounds its optimizer's gap below by λ*−log(n−1)/t; compactness gives the long limit. Its first two weights have strict reversed order when n>3, hence there is a finite crossing by continuity. For the curvature ratio, Qshort=B²/(sum y) with sum y=n/6+O(1); summing the long design's squared eigenvalues gives Qlong=12B²(3n²−2)/(5n(n²−1)). Their ratio tends to 6/5, not a ratio of heat traces. Independent Fraction computations for n=4 through 10 corroborate the exact linear systems and spectra, and for n=4 give Qshort=7/4 and Qlong=46/25 for a unit budget. The all-size and all-horizon claims rely on the proof, not the frozen numerical execution count.
residual_risks: No claimed finite-time closed form, monotonicity, uniqueness of a crossing, or interiority at every t. Bounded exact runs are not all-time verification.

value.rationale: On the same graph family and with the same budget, a natural observation objective genuinely switches which boundary edge receives more conductance. This holds for every n≥4, rather than an arbitrary small example, and the explicit short profile gives a mechanism. The asymptotically nonzero 20% excess quantifies the cost of using the familiar gap-optimal design for the first variable short-time coefficient.
residual_risks: The percentage is asymptotic in path order and applies only to the second-moment coefficient, not a finite-time performance guarantee.
